provenance_note: From a multi-sign interior wayfinding package. All client, vendor, designer, building/department/room names, street address, project numbers, and the ADA-assistance phone number excluded at extraction. Higher-education vertical retained. Room copy excluded; copy structure retained as pattern.

program_model.instance_model: one ADA room-ID design produced in a few standard sizes (small/medium/large, with and without changeable insert; sign-type codes across the S-series) and deployed in quantity; permanent tactile copy is fabricated per door, the directory/occupant line is a changeable paper insert behind a non-glare window

knowledge.plain_language_summary: A built-up acrylic ADA room-identification sign: painted acrylic plaque carrying laser-cut raised tactile copy and braille for permanent room information, plus a changeable paper insert held behind a clear non-glare matte acrylic window for occupant or function copy that changes over time. Finished with an ADA non-glare clear coat.
knowledge.rationale: Splitting permanent tactile identification from a changeable insert satisfies ADA (raised characters and braille at the door) while letting occupant names change without refabricating the tactile sign.
knowledge.tradeoffs: Laser-cut tactile plus braille plus an insert window is more fabrication than a flat printed sign, but it is the compliant, durable, serviceable standard for institutional room ID.
knowledge.when_to_use: Any permanent interior room that requires ADA identification and whose occupant or function copy may change.

structure.function: primary plaque body and tactile field
structure.construction: built-up/laminated acrylic plate, front and edges painted; built-up header detail where used
laser-cut ADA-compliant raised tactile letters with Grade 2 braille
clear non-glare matte acrylic window over a changeable paper insert

materials_manifest.product: Clear P95 non-glare medium matte acrylic sheet (insert window)
Matthews MP00817 Alga Green (department color), satin
Matthews (MAP) SOA 4158SP ADA non-glare clear coat

dimensions.note: Multiple coded sizes (small/medium/large room-ID variants); package states sizes need not be finalized prior to fabrication, so exact per-size dimensions left to the size schedule.

compliance.notes: Laser-cut raised tactile copy with braille; non-glare matte insert window and ADA non-glare clear coat on all interior signs. Mounting height not dimensioned on this design-intent set.

rules_observations: Permanent tactile/braille separated from changeable insert keeps the compliant identification stable while occupant copy changes.
Department color is the only varying accent, holding family consistency across the program.
craft_observations: Built-up/laminated acrylic with painted edges and a non-glare insert window is the institutional standard; laser-cut tactile plus braille is the compliant, durable execution.
Non-glare matte over the insert addresses ADA glare while keeping the changeable copy legible.

aesthetic_notes.note: Quiet, system-driven institutional ID; restraint and consistency are the design value here, not expression.

open_items: ADA mounting height not dimensioned on the design-intent set
